description: Mortalidad por accidentes de tránsito is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Salud - SDS. Monitorear el comportamiento de la mortalidad por accidentes de transito, identificando grupos vulnerables que requieren prevención del evento en Bogotá D.C. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Salud - SDS. Its tags are Salud Bogotá, Secretaria de Salud, salud, salud bogota. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
